name: Mouse-Reactive Portal Cards + Interaction System
key_changes: Implemented reusable InteractiveSurface component with subtle 3D tilt and cursor spotlight tracking.
Replaced basic hover states on Portal cards and Ecosystem maps with the new InteractiveSurface.
Added a MagneticButton component for primary CTAs that translates slightly toward the cursor.
Wired both interactions to be disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, and bound them only to fine pointers (mouse) to preserve touch UX.
Preserved semantic structure and keyboard navigation parity.
deferred_items: Cinematic intro loading sequence (scheduled for Phase 5D)
